scope: One short-lived Ed25519 admission for the exact current-architecture read-system-facts handoff after a verified one-time consumption record. This layer binds policy and evidence but still performs no process, filesystem-read target effect, network effect, deployment or capability promotion.
core_invariant: Durable consumption prevents replay but does not create effect authority. A separately trusted issuer may admit only the exact consumed read-system-facts handoff under the exact reviewed Linux isolation policy and exact candidate revision, and the eventual adapter must still recheck A6 currentness at the actual effect boundary.

controls: issuer key digest in signed statement

risks: change executor or input after consume
controls: exact handoff/input/executor/consumption digest and storage-key equality

risks: admit code other than reviewed candidate

controls: not_before and expires_at inside A4 window
not_before cannot precede consumption effect/currentness boundary

risks: treat consume-time currentness as sufficient forever
controls: eventual adapter must invoke A6 again at actual effect time

known_nonclaims: The operation-specific isolation policy is a requirement/binding object, not enforcement evidence.
The admission does not perform read-system-facts or any target effect.
The admission does not prove A6 currentness at the later actual effect boundary; it requires that recheck.

The admission does not create a general executor, repository-code execution path, arbitrary command/path authority, network authority, credential/secret access, remote-hardware authority, production authority, deployment authority, or capability promotion.
Hosted CI in the policy does not prove physical-device isolation.
A later effect receipt is required before A5b may claim the concrete bounded effect.
next_gates: implement current-main fixed hosted-Linux adapter that independently reverifies admission, consumed record and A6 currentness immediately before process effect
emit signed executor-originated read-system-facts effect receipt with exact isolation observation and bounded outputs
independently reverify the effect receipt in A5b alongside A5a rather than inferring effect from Grid completion
run exact-head protected Linux effect workflow and preserve failures as evidence
obtain independent effect-path review before any promotion decision
